title: Nowcasting and forecasting infectious disease dynamics
text:
A set of freely available, open-source materials for learning about nowcasting and forecasting infectious disease dynamics.
We invite anyone to use the materials here in their own teaching and learning. For questions and discussion of the course or its content, we welcome all users to the Discussion board. We welcome all forms of contributions, additions and suggestions for improving the materials.
All materials here are provided under the permissive MIT License.
